# Multi-vendor E-commerce Backend

Node.js, TypeScript, Express, MongoDB, and Mongoose backend generated from the 171 table definitions in ../data-base.txt.

## Setup

1. Copy .env.example to .env and set a 32-character JWT_SECRET and MONGODB_URI.
2. Run npm install.
3. Run npm run typecheck, then npm run dev.

CRUD endpoints are mounted under /api/v1/<resource>. Every route requires a signed bearer token with a permissions claim. Permission values follow <entity-kebab-case>:create|read|update|delete; * grants all operations. Tokens must be issued by a trusted identity provider.

List endpoints accept page and limit (1-100). IDs are MongoDB ObjectIds. Entities containing IsDelete are soft-deleted; other entities use physical deletion. Cross-document SQL constraints and transactional workflows described in data-base.txt are not implied by these CRUD endpoints and require dedicated transactional use cases.
